AUTHOR: Shevchenko
TITLE: Fish Detection from Low Visibility Underwater Videos
DATA: Own/partner fishway videos from 'Kymijoen vesi ja ympäristö ry': Dataset 1 (2013, 4 videos), Dataset 2 (2016, 6 videos)
V_EV: Sec. IV-A: 'It consists of four videos with different types of natural illumination and various water qualities'; 'average distance between the camera and the fish is 55 cm'
D2: no train/test split (unsupervised background subtraction; parameters set empirically per dataset)
D_EV: Sec. IV-C: 'Parameters used for post-processing for BS were chosen empirically' - no train/validation/test split described
R_EV: Sec. IV-A: both datasets 'gathered by the same organization' at the same fish pass; no model trained on one and tested on the other
C_EV: no statement found (only IoU matching threshold 0.5 and region-merging distance thresholds; no detection score threshold or FP verification)
E_EV: Sec. IV-B: 'For each video the number of true positive, true negative, false positive and false negative frames were counted' - only P/R/F1 reported
ARCH: Background subtraction (Adaptive GMM, KDE, ViBe) + morphology, optical flow, connected-component heuristics
METR: Precision, Recall, F1 at IoU 0.5; F1 vs IoU threshold
NOTE: INCL borderline on criterion (a): classical statistical background subtraction (GMM/KDE/ViBe), no supervised learning; included as ML-based detection - verifier should confirm. Fish-pass tube camera on river. V6=P: per-video/per-dataset results with qualitative explanation that Dataset 2 'videos are darker' (no measured visibility). Datasets from 2013 vs 2016 at same site but no training, so R not applicable as external test (R1=N). Fish size estimation and direction heuristic computed but not evaluated -> E1=없음.
